name: routine_status_op
description: Change a routine's runtime status: enable/disable it, run its if/then/else branch directly, stop it, change run-at-startup, or delete it. Use create_or_update_routine to change what a routine actually does, not this tool. delete is a real, permanent change, gated by a code-enforced two-call confirm: call once with no confirmed (or confirmed: false) to preview -- this does not delete anything -- then call again with confirmed: true only after the customer has explicitly agreed, never speculatively. One routine per call -- call it once per routine.

id.description: The routine's real id, exactly as shown in ROUTINES DATABASE -- never guessed.

confirmed.description: delete only. Leave unset (or false) for the first call, which only previews -- no side effects. Set to true only on a follow-up call, only after the customer has explicitly agreed to delete it.
